architectureIfKeep.kind: Deterministic two-route state machine; zero model fits.
architectureIfKeep.noRescue: No alternative guard, fallback, Event, model or architecture after Candidate FAIL.
architectureIfKeep.routeA: At t0 only: all three frozen AVAILABLE anchor fields directionalMomentum3Pct>0, directionalMomentumAccelerationPct>=0, relativeVolume5>=1 -> BUY_NOW. Any unavailable field means guard false. Same rule for INITIAL/DIP; values remain anchor snapshots.
architectureIfKeep.routeB: Otherwise watch selected first causal event through 30 minutes. On event BUY at next scheduled OPEN. If no event at30 and prefix/reference valid and inside original segment, explicit BUY_AT_CAP fallback. Boundary/missing -> terminal EXPIRE/UNKNOWN. No future-label routing.
architectureIfKeep.selection: First KEEP in fixed mechanicPriority; no best-result selection. Exactly one architecture. Contract artifact and source hashes committed before any Validation execution.
architectureIfKeep.trainGate: Measure whole architecture on TRAIN after contract creation. Require exact inherited full Entry gates before opening Validation; failure LIMIT.

authorization: User 2026-09-19 v3 directive. Bounded TRAIN event diagnostics first.

candidateEconomicGate.pairing: Identical opportunity ids per pair. Report no-entry cash0 separately from entered-only. Missing entered outcome is UNKNOWN excluded explicitly, never 0. HOLD/MFE/MAE included.
candidateEconomicGate.policy: Exact frozen Candidate A + exact Fixed12 fallback, unchanged 0.05pp. New entry starts own fixed12 calendar cap. Signal next-open semantics unchanged.
candidateEconomicGate.requirements: Economic evaluable >=90% of common baseline; mean net delta>=.05pp, PF nonworse, p05 nonworse; both sources mean delta>=0; >=3/4 blocks net delta>=0; TRAIN-top3 exclusion delta>0.

candidateEntryGates.chronological: At least3/4 subblocks commonN>=20, +3/+5 preservation>=.80 where denominator exists, price improvement mean>=0; no subgroup thresholds/rules.
candidateEntryGates.cohorts: INITIAL and DIP each complete n>=30, entry coverage>=.60, +3/+5 preservation>=.85, strict30 entered-paired p05 no worse by more than.25pp.
candidateEntryGates.concentration: Exclude TRAIN-frequency top3 symbols (tie symbol ascending); same full overall entry gates excluding minimum sample / pullback cohort nesting. No blacklist.
candidateEntryGates.pullback: PULLBACK+DEEP_PULLBACK combined n>=10, paired entered mean price improvement>=0.10pp and strict30 median MAE nonworse, +3 preservation>=.85. Deep separately descriptive (tiny n cannot certify).

candidateSelection: TRAIN full Entry pass -> contract already committed -> VALIDATION exactly once. Entry pass -> exact Candidate A economic; both pass -> DEV TEST once. DEV TEST failure stops with no replacement. No candidate if no KEEP mechanic.

completion.limit: COMPREHENSIVE_LONG_ENTRY_V3_DEVELOPMENT_LIMIT_REACHED / no candidate freeze; scoped only to these nine structural Event families and saved 5m substrate; preserve upstream and STOP.

evaluator.fastWinner: Exact v2 first completed post-entry HIGH>=1 AND common60 MFE>=3; evaluator only.
evaluator.immediateRequired: Evaluator-only tag on NO_EVENT/EXPIRED and original IMMEDIATE_WINNER; never a policy input or proof that only t0 works.
evaluator.oracle: Not computed; no future low used even as target.
evaluator.pathClasses: Exact pinned v1 path_class executable precedence; no relabel. INCONCLUSIVE includes same-bar winner/adverse ambiguity.
evaluator.window: Same original opportunity+60 minutes common endpoint within segment; original complete baseline is primary denominator. strict30 from each own entry for MAE. Incomplete/missing cases retained outside complete denominator.
evaluator.winnerBeforeEvent: Baseline first +3/+5 hit bar completed by event timestamp. No-event winners reported separately.

eventExecution: First recognition only. Completed bar ending t -> next regular OPEN starting t. OPEN only in execution layer; never buy signal LOW or CLOSE. Missing OPEN = UNKNOWN_EXECUTION. Persist event timestamp separately from execution outcome. No best-later event substitution.

events.E1_PULLBACK: First completed post-opportunity CLOSE strictly below fixed opportunity reference OPEN. Zero is a structural sign, no magnitude threshold.
events.E2_STABILIZATION: After an earlier E1 bar: current LOW>=previous LOW, CLOSE>=previous CLOSE, and current range<=previous range. All comparisons use completed bars.
events.E3_RECLAIM: After an earlier E1 bar: current CLOSE>previous completed bar HIGH.
events.E4_MOMENTUM_TURN: After an earlier E1 bar and at least 3 completed post-opportunity bars: previous close-to-close change<=0 and current close-to-close change>0.
events.E5_FAILED_BREAKDOWN: After an earlier E1 bar: current LOW<previous LOW and current CLOSE>previous LOW. Only low vs terminal CLOSE is used, never HIGH-before-LOW ordering.
events.E6_CONTINUATION: At least 3 completed post-opportunity bars: two consecutive positive close changes, two consecutive higher LOWs, and current HIGH>previous HIGH. Does not require pullback.
events.S1_P_S_R: E1 -> E2 -> E3, strictly later completed-bar timestamps for every transition.
events.S2_P_F_R: E1 -> E5 -> E3, strictly later completed-bar timestamps for every transition.
events.S3_P_S_M: E1 -> E2 -> E4, strictly later completed-bar timestamps for every transition.

integrity: PIT completed-prefix state and Event timestamp causality

mechanicKeepGate.chronological: Four contiguous TRAIN date blocks; >=3/4 with PB baseline>=10 and failure baseline>=10, PB event>=3, occurrence gap>=0, PB mean price improvement>=0, PB strict30 median improvement>=0.
mechanicKeepGate.cohorts: INITIAL and DIP each PB event n>=5, PB mean price improvement>=0, strict30 median improvement>=0, remaining MFE paired mean ratio>=.85. No cohort exclusion.
mechanicKeepGate.concentration: PB entered max single-symbol fraction<=.25 and max single-session fraction<=.25; exclude TRAIN opportunity-frequency top3 (symbol ascending tie) and repeat full combined PB gates except sample minima, nesting, chronology and concentration. Diagnostic exclusion only, never policy blacklist.
mechanicKeepGate.interpretation: KEEP is a TRAIN mechanic hypothesis, not whole-population Entry PASS. Low Immediate/Fast preservation is reported even if a pullback mechanic qualifies. No resampling or threshold rescue.
mechanicKeepGate.zeroDenominator: Undefined required conditional rate = not demonstrated, FAIL; never 100% by default.

states.available: Only contiguous valid bars with end<=decision timestamp. Op reference is frozen known OPEN. Latest signal bar HIGH/LOW/CLOSE not used for execution OPEN.
states.boundary: No morning/afternoon crossing; t must remain strictly inside original segment.
states.context: Unchanged v1 43 PIT features/snapshot semantics. Dynamic volume/VWAP/relative-strength/market-index paths absent from saved substrate: explicitly UNAVAILABLE, no invented update. Legacy anchor values remain timestamp-pinned context only. No feature/model selection.
states.missing: Missing initial reference or completed prefix is terminal UNKNOWN; never resurrect. Boundary before cap is EXPIRED. Complete cap with no event is NO_EVENT; not a SKIP recommendation.

studyScope: TRAIN only. Source loading may read immutable bundled 76-session files to verify identity, but filter to TRAIN before features, event reconstruction, path classification or outcome evaluation. No Validation/DEV TEST v3 diagnostic access.
